title: Extraction Chamber
keywords: Turns dirt/cobblestone into Soil/Small Stone and can find dirty or damaged circuits

blocks.text: Turns dirt/cobblestone into Soil/Small Stone and can find dirty or damaged circuits. It produces raw circuits, not analysed boards.

rows: Choose dirt or cobblestone according to the recipe.
Supply the complete batch cost and wait through the duration.
Separate guaranteed material output from chance-based circuit output.

blocks.text: Not receiving a chip on every cycle is expected for chance results. Use Precision recipes when you need a more specific route.
